### Added

- (gs) [Add Gateways tab to the cluster detail page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2706) by [@weatherhog](https://github.com/weatherhog) — A cluster's page has a Gateways tab: its Gateways with their listeners, and its HTTPRoutes with their parents and `Accepted` and `ResolvedRefs` conditions, failing routes first. Read from the installation's metrics; clusters on an observability-bundle older than 3.6.0 show `Not available`.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Refuse an answer to a request the task no longer asks](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3331) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — When an agent's question was already answered in Slack and the agent asked another, an answer sent from the session page is refused instead of being applied to the new question you never saw.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Run node-build's tests on two containers](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3330) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — CircleCI's node-build job splits the unit tests across two containers, cutting the job from 10 to 12 minutes to about 6 to 7, for about a fifth more credits.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.28.3...v3.29.0
